Supervisors see only their own teams, everywhere.

GOOD TO KNOW

Languages: the console, the agent desk and what customers read (emails, SMS, ticket notices, surveys, the help centre, the chat widget, payment links and quotes) now come in French, Portuguese, Spanish, German, Dutch, Afrikaans, isiZulu and Swahili as well as English. Each person picks their own language under their name (Language and time); a customer reads in their own language, else their queue's, else the organisation's. Wording you wrote yourself (templates, articles, quick replies) is always sent as written. The translations are drafts until a native speaker reviews them; Arabic can be chosen for dates and numbers, and its screens follow once right-to-left is ready.

Country, time zone and formats: each organisation now has a country, a language for dates and numbers, a time zone and the day its week starts (Settings). Each person can set their own language and time zone. Times on screen show in your own zone, never your browser's; reports count days and weeks in the organisation's zone and say so. Phone numbers typed without a country code are read in the client's or organisation's country, and examples show that country's numbers. Existing organisations stay South Africa, English and Monday, so nothing moves for them.

Supervisors see their own teams: a supervisor named on teams now sees only those teams' agents, queues, calls, tickets and conversations everywhere — the floor, the live monitor, the real-time view, every standard report, your own reports, dashboards, drill-downs, exports and scheduled reports — with "Limited to your teams." on each. Administrators, and supervisors on no team, still see everything.

Signing in: the sign-in screen asks for your work email first; an address on a domain your organisation verified for Microsoft or Google goes straight there.

The nightly 04:00 restart of the call servers no longer sends emails, and neither do planned updates: a server being updated is given a quiet window, and only a service that does not come back is reported.

FOR AGENTS

Tickets time themselves: the timer under Time spent starts when you start working a ticket and pauses when you leave it or stop for a few minutes, counting only up to your last activity (administrators can change the minutes or switch it off under Ticket settings).

Your own photo: upload a photo as your avatar and place it in the circle; location and camera details are removed. Administrators can switch photo uploads off.

Attach file now sends the file with the reply from the console's ticket page as well as the desk, and a file on a ticket can be up to 50 MB (the files on one reply must still fit the mailbox's own limit, set under Messaging).

FOR SUPERVISORS

Compare with: every report can show the period before, the same period last year or days you choose beside it, with the change and a trend line, in exports and scheduled reports too.

What changed: when a figure moved, one sentence says which queue, campaign, agent and hours explain it, with the calls, tickets or conversations behind each part a click away. It works on call, ticket, conversation, agent time and pause reports and on your own reports.

Targets: set a target for any figure for the organisation, a queue, a campaign, a team or an agent (Report targets); reports, the dashboard and wallboards show it met or missed.

Dashboards: build your own from any report, as numbers, charts, tables or gauges against target, with filters for the whole dashboard; share it, make it a role's home page, open it as a wallboard or on a TV with its own link, and have it emailed as a PDF. Ready-made dashboards "}
